retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-inspired layout featuring a central circular photographic window framed by a solid dark border and stacked retro typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central circular photographic portal showing a group of people posed on stone steps within an ancient archway, surrounded by a heavy dark brown border with distressed edges and stylized 1970s display typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular photographic window centered within a square frame
Stacked typography positioned above the circular cutout
Stone architectural lines echoing the verticality of the subjects
Distressed, grainy texture applied to the outer border
coreInvariants: Stacked hierarchy of display and subtitle text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centrally located within the circular window, scaled to fill the vertical height of the stone staircase.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular cutout acts as the primary focal point, anchored by the dark brown surrounding negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large stylized title, move down to the subtitle, and then into the circular portal to the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark brown negative space in the corners and edges to create a 'tunnel' effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark border and the lighter stone interior.

letterConstructionRules: Subtitle uses a high-contrast, rounded display face
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are segmented into horizontal bars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, textured display face paired with a cleaner, rounded sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the multi-line geometric feel of the era
Matches the rounded geometric subtitle style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a dark brown border. In the center, place a circular photographic window showing a group of people in 70s attire sitting on stone steps inside a medieval-style archway. Apply a grainy, aged paper texture to the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered text at the top. The first line should be large, magenta, and have horizontal line cutouts. The second line should be white, rounded, and bold.

verificationChecks: Is the central image contained within a perfect circle?
Does the title text have horizontal line segments?
Is the border a dark, earthy brown?
Is there a visible grain or distress texture?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the circle
Verify the horizontal line texture is present in the display font
recipe.reuseFormula: Circular mask + Dark brown border + Segmented display type + Stone architectural photography
